execution.ref: CHALLENGE-AI-COOLING-07 final combined canonical regression audit
execution.description: Ran Cooling, neutral scoring, Graphite Phase 3/4, miner path, pod timeout and Battery compatibility suites together after registering Cooling as a second scorer.

expected: Shared paths should require an exact Challenge while every Challenge-specific production path and fixture supplies one explicitly.
observed: The complete run found 38 failures clustered in four legacy single-Challenge assumptions: direct miner-path checks, Planner next-level fixture briefs without a registered Challenge, Phase 4's internal Experiment and runner providers omitting their selected scorer, and pod-timeout fixtures omitting Battery's scorer. All other selected tests passed.
keep: Keep unnamed shared scoring fail closed; do not restore an implicit Battery default.
Keep Battery and Cooling scientific rules and contracts unchanged.
change: Thread the selected scorer through Phase 4's Experiment, dry run and live provider.
Bind the Planner fixture brief, miner-path assertions and pod-timeout fixtures to their exact registered Challenge.
